name: Castle
about: Lower the drawbridge, collect the gems and get into the castle. Shows maps, a moving map, vox characters with a walk cycle, pal() recolors, outlines, sound, music, a title card and a saved best time.

name: Block Pop
about: Click or tap a group of same-colored blocks to pop it. Shows mouse_ray() and mray() for clicking blocks, and mget/mset to change a map while playing.

name: Tilt Maze
about: Tilt the maze to roll a marble to the flag. Shows collision on a rotated map: mgetw() pushes the marble out of a maze that tilts under it.

name: Scrambler
about: A carnival ride built from maps that spin on their pivots; one arm map and one car map are each drawn several times a frame. Hop in a car for the ride view.

name: First Person
about: Find the key in a dungeon maze and escape. Shows a first-person camera with mouse capture (or a finger drag), sphere collision, mray() to see what you face, and gates that are maps of their own.

name: Builder
about: Build on a plot block by block: place on the face you point at, dig, pick from a hotbar. Shows mray() with its face direction, a clickable 2D hotbar, and save()/load() keeping your build.

name: Bumper Arena
about: Bump the other cars off a crumbling platform, with up to 4 players on gamepads and the computer filling empty seats. Shows input for players 0-3, pal() and outline() per player, and mset() changing the arena.

name: Third Person
about: Hop across floating islands for 5 stars, riding a sliding platform, a turning bridge and an elevator. Shows an orbit camera kept out of walls with mray(), and riding moving maps with wtom() and mtow().
